newsitem.title: USA: Missouri university loses $10 mln arena donation.
newsitem.headline: Missouri university loses $10 mln arena donation.

text.p: A donor has withdrawn his offer to provide $10 million toward a new 17,000 seat basketball arena for the University of Missouri at Columbia, a university spokesman said Thursday.

Loss of the donation has not killed plans for a new $60 million arena, however, and the university is in the process of setting up a fundraising drive to pay for the project, spokesman Maurice Manring said.
Manring said there were no immediate plans to issue bonds to help finance the arena, but said the university's board of curators could always consider issuance of revenue bonds down the road.
The donor, Bill Laurie, notified the university Tuesday he was withdrawing the donation because officials could not guarantee that the project would be completed by January 2000, Manring said.
The university recently approved design plans for the arena and it could still be ready by that time, Manring said.
